title: bosnian serb general ratko mladic convicted genocide has died serbian tv reports 2026 08 27
text: BELGRADE, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Bosnian ​Serb general ‌Ratko Mladic, who ​was serving ​a life sentence ⁠for ​genocide in ​the bloody 1992-95 war ​in ​Bosnia, has died ‌in ⁠the United Nations detention centre ​in ​The ⁠Hague, Belgrade's ​Informer ​TV ⁠reported on Thursday.
